items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: there was a fellow named Rusty Jones, he was from the Midwest, and he played trombone. ... And he played with him.

ctx.x: Who was the band? There was no name.

The drummer was the leader but there was no name to the band. But like I said, I'll tell you who played in the band, Henry Ross, Hank Ross, do you ever heard of him? He got to be a very good tenor man around New York. And what he was doing just a few years ago when Perry Comer had the show, he was the music coordinator on the Perry Comer show. Yeah, I've heard of him but I can't remember. And then Hank Ross was playing tenor and his brother, his brother named Henry, no Henry and I can't think of his brother's…
Well you went on that show and you came back here, I got confused now, you played at the Beverly Gardens.
